transport.content: Ilex intends to clear the counter before the final tram departs, viewing the unsent parcel as an unbalanced ledger entry. He will not offer the package as a gift, nor will he speculate on the unverified rumor of a sleeper beneath the viaduct. Instead, he plans to slide the stamped parcel toward Mira with a dry, precise motion, stating only, "The last tram leaves in ten minutes. This item requires a signature to close the day's accounts." He waits for her to accept the responsibility or decline it, ready to re-shelve the parcel if she refuses, as he refuses to owe favors to those who do not settle their debts.

transport.content:
Ilex will not hand over the sealed parcel to the courier, as doing so would breach his promise to the intended recipient and create an unbalanced ledger of favors. With the last tram approaching, his priority is to secure the counter and close the books rather than engage with the courier's request or the unverified rumor of a sleeper beneath the viaduct. He intends to maintain a stoic silence, focusing on the final entry in his log, unless the courier persists, in which case he will respond with a flat refusal.

Possible line: "The ledger is closed to unauthorized transfers. The parcel remains sealed until the recipient arrives. The tram leaves in three minutes; I will not be waiting."
